decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The Victorian Veranda Staircase gantry shall be removed and stored in a secure manner to facilitate its re-erection elsewhere; and a scheme submitted to the Council within 4 months (124 days) from the date of this permission outlining reasonable efforts that have been made by the applicant to market the structure to specialist groups. The scheme shall be then be implemented in accordance with the approved scheme and written and photographic confirmation supplied to the local planning authority
description:
Removal of condition 10 (Victorian Veranda) of approved permission dated 15/2/01 to allow the removal and storage of the gantry subject to the following condition: 

The Victorian Veranda Staircase gantry shall be removed and stored in a secure manner to facilitate its re-erection elsewhere; and a scheme submitted to the Council within 4 months (124 days) from the date of this permission outlining reasonable efforts that have been made by the applicant to market the structure to specialist groups. The scheme shall be then be implemented in accordance with the approved scheme and written and photographic confirmation supplied to the local planning authority

Reason: To allow ample time for the marketability of the structure to be investigated without compromising the building schedule for the hospital.
